attributes.board_name: South Carolina Board of Examiners for Licensure of Professional Counselors, Marriage and Family Therapists, Addiction Counselors and Psycho-Educational Specialists

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved CE; programs sponsored by a professional counselor, addiction counselor or MFT certifying body or Board-approved sponsoring body (or its divisions) are automatically approved; others need approval 90 days in advance. Up to 20 hours via first-time presentations (max 5), refereed publications (max 5), new course preparation (max 5). In person or online.
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE for the licensing period in which the initial license was obtained.

topics.who: Ethical standards related to the marriage and family therapy license
All licensees: suicide assessment, treatment and management
Licensed marriage and family therapy supervisors: supervision of their discipline

rules.notes: 40 hours per two-year licensure period, 33 of them related to the license. Holders of more than one license need 50 hours.
rules.rule_quote: (1) Persons licensed as professional counselors, addiction counselors, or marriage and family therapists shall complete forty (40) hours of Board-approved continuing education…
